notes: `name` is not a variant axis — it selects a path from the generated registry in ./glyphs.ts rather than a class. It is typed as `GlyphName`, a union of the 50 committed glyph names, so a bad literal is a compile error; a name arriving as a plain `string` at runtime is not checked and renders nothing.

Props spread onto the <svg> before `viewBox`, `data-ds-part` and `className`, so those three cannot be overridden from outside. The accessibility attributes are applied BEFORE the spread on purpose, so a caller can add their own — with the caveat recorded in the contract's a11y notes.
Children are omitted from the prop type. The glyph is the entire content, and an <svg> that accepted children would let a caller draw over the set.
